purpose: Authored static inventory and prior-qualification index; not a production loader admission registry
scopeLimits: All target artifacts were read statically; no target code was executed.
Named role or exports alone do not establish valid construction, live.device ABI compatibility, input/output routing, sound, state fidelity, or Alive admission.
Documented Max inlet/outlet signatures establish installed documentation only, not measured behavior.
Other Live devices can be embedded in the host executable/engine; inventory cannot locate all implementations or prove no additional DSP exists.
Unrelated Windows system libraries, .wine prefixes without Ableton name, unknown custom VST locations, network storage, archives and embedded installer payloads are outside scope.
A candidate without an MZ header is retained by known suffix and explicitly reported; all-files MZ screening finds DLLs with nonstandard suffixes.
